notes.title: New Content, “Fam Occupation” UPDATE!
notes.notes:
Fam competition content “Fam Occupation” is updated and open until November 4 @10PM (Pacific Time)!

[!!FAM OCCUPATION UPDATE!!] 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/02f3cbe8eed13c4a90ce2592daec14d5b6c46309.png

WHAT IS FAM OCCUPATION?
For limited period, conquer tiles as many as you can. And acquire ‘POINT’. A FAM with most point wins.

CONDITION TO JOIN
If you want to join, you should satisfy these condition.
CAN JOIN : 
-. Anyone who joined to a Fam.
CAN NOT JOIN :
 -. Someone who joined a Fam after “Fam Occupation” starts.
 -. Someone who changes(include quit/ban/disband ) a Fam.

HOW TO JOIN
Click Fam occupation Icon and activate “Fam Occupation” page.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/ffeeaed47eb7cc1fbdee0e35c91d13b52b756653.png
Click this icon at menu.

PROCESS OF FAM OCCUPATION
Fam Occupation repeats every week during the period.
FAM OCCUPATION STARTS : Every Thursday 18:00
FAM OCCUPATION ENDS : Every Sunday 23:00
RECEIVE REWARDS : From Monday 00:00 to Tuesday 23:00

RECEIVING TICKETS
10 tickets will be charged 00:00 every day during the period. Unused tickets expire before charging. Please use it. You can have a maximum of 10 tickets.

HOW TO PLAY
At map, you can check Occupation status real time.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/b48565013ba3a4d18317a4369841f2480ded9151.jpg

Not Occupied
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/3d899a20d0c165e4e5999e116e81fbfe0ebb4b62.png

Occupied by our FAM
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/33d6194d0bf4ad6e8713161bdc66c5d0cbe49706.png

Occupied by other FAM
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/775ee2231f02c6fa4b7641ec6734c435753c6be7.png


HOW TO CHECK OCCUPYING CONDITION
When you click a tile, You can check Tile’s condition to conquer.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/2fb19582cfe8b8f14ce9fda30379f55f742e9ce1.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/743a7f7a965ce88c6cd743ed08c662eb4b3861d8.png

HOW TO CHECK OCCUPATION AVAILABLE TILE(ON/OFF)
Click “Not occupied” button at right menu to toggle. On/Off.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/a83a06e49f5aa57cf0734c2429d0fd0530973658.png

FAM OCCUPATION WAITINGROOM
You can make Fam Occupation waitroom when this condition is met.
-. You should be able to join Fam Occupation.
-. You should have enough LEVEL to try.
-. You should have tickets equal to or greater than the tile’s required tickets..

If your fam member make a waitingroom for fam occupation, you can enter th room. (You should have enough level and tickets too).

OCCUPATION SUCCESS/FAIL
At result screen, you will know Occupation was successful.

OCCUPATION POINT
- When you are successful, you receive ‘Occupation Point’.
- If you lost a tile to another Fam, you will lost received ‘Occupation Point’ 
- There is two kind of Occupation Point.
-. Tile Occupation Point : Point for each Tile.
-. Area Occupation Bonus : When you occupy a group of tile, you will receive ‘Area Occupation Bunus’. There is 14 group.

RANKING
- Ranking Calculation
 -. When Fam Occupation ends, Ranking will be calculated.
 -. Ranking is determined by total Occupation Point 
-. When you score a tie
  -. In this case. These Fam are count as ‘Lowest rank’ of their point.
    Example : When Fam ‘A’ scores 50 and Fam ‘B’, ‘C’ scores 35. They are ranked as 3rd place. Not 2nd


REWARD
You will receive rewards as below.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/194ae9e8da4da442abb06ef3f651d8b7346e6dc4.png

You can get one if these from Accessory Box (rare)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/e794dd19c9370942b9e0cc82fa158e4b96466476.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/f87724575672890dd22ca845fd344d043369d601.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/24308bcf629339027a723e57965a6f444a97757f.png

NOTICE
When you are detected as an abuser or is using hack, your account and Fam members can be imposed sanctions. Please be careful and play fair.

notes.notes:
Treasure hunt has been renewed and Trade system updated.

Treasure Hunt Renewal

- Number of treasure materials increased to 60.

 - game mode

 - Lovetree

 - Level up bonus
 - Material Randombox


Trade System Update

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/9965aae8c603db5ae9d619eefa79f1bc00cf1848.png

- Trade System is…
  Trading system between treasure materials and ‘heart’

How To Trade
1. At waiting room, click and select trade. When opponent accept, trade pop up opens.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/8cce09421336078c50db736077b42fbc8db51191.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/bbc8e659e53870550e5a99fc18037478eeaf434a.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/dc734106fcb5d913011afab71da001384f92e2f2.png

2. Select trading items.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/d2e264ed7fcd622f412f4d163fda62110c538661.png

3. When you trade material, Please select material and number.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/90645a185af80bfc303ee5488ab0939c4cdf5173.png

4. If you trade heart, please input number of hearts.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/1f76fd9e12fec68994a0b67b583e3c09e7511236.png

5. when items are selected correctly, Click ‘Item Lock’ Button.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/1d5c4f2190b0916bf640112019cee962f11820cc.png

6. When Both user do Item Lock, ‘Make deal’ button activates.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/bbe53b546eefd3f2390398d888274cec54e973b6.png

7. After both player agree deal, trade ends.

Before trade, Don’t forget trading fee!

1. For each slot, 5 heart will be charged as fee
2. Trade fee increases proportionally by number of registered heart. (15% as fee)
3. Only buyer pays trade fee.
4. When trade is done, trade fee is reduced before heart is sent to the other.

notes.title: Hotfix 02.03.2020
notes.notes:
We updated a game to fix an error which the game doesn't run. Please restart the Steam client to download this update.

Patch Note
1. Fixed an error which the game doesn't run.

If the problem persists after this update
Please try our basic troubleshooting as in following:

1. Run Windows and Steam as an administrator:
- How to:
  A. Windows Admin.
    1) Select “Start” and type “CMD“.
    2) Right-click “Command Prompt” then choose “Run as administrator“.
    3) If prompted, enter a username and password that grants admin rights to the computer.
    4) Type: net user administrator /active:yes
    5) Press “Enter“.
  B. Steam
    1) Right-click Steam
    2) Run it as an administrator
2. End unnecessary programs and anti-virus programs.
3. Allow the game through Windows Firewall.
4. Update your Windows and graphic drivers up to dated.
5. Delete a GameGuard folder located in LoveBeat installation directory.

If your issue doesn't resolve with the troubleshooting above, please submit your information to lovebeat_cs@crazydiamond.co.kr:

a. Steam account
b. LoveBeat avatar's name (if you have)
c. Detailed description of your problem
d. Screenshot or videos showing your problem (if available)
e. DxDiag.txt
 - How to create it?
   1) Press Windows Key + R.
   2) Type DxDiag and press Enter.
   3) In the DxDiag window, click Save All Information.
   4) Name the file "dxdiag" and click Save.
   5) Exit the DirectX Diagnostic Tool.
f. GameGuard.zip
  - How to create it?
   1) Navigate to your LoveBeat installation directory
   2) Right-click on GameGuard folder
   3) Hover your cursor over the “Send to” option. it will open a new submenu
   4) Select “Compressed (zipped) folder”

notes.title: [Notice] GameGuard Issue (Update)
notes.notes:
Hello, This is GMLove.
First of all, I apologize for the difficulty and frustration.
I've got the report from many players about hacking, cheating and other inappropriate things, so my team updated GameGuard which is game security solution on July 11. We updated GameGuard to improve game security on July 27, but many players have reported problems after that. Therefore, we did roll back previous version @ 8:35 PM on July 28. (Pacific time) I apologize for GameGuard issue once again and will recover LB stamp on July 27, 28 for compensation. You will check the stamp on July 29.
If your problem continues, please check basic troubleshooting below and Contact LoveBeat support when you cannot resolve it with the guide. We will investigate your issue to resolve it as soon as possible.
I appreciate your interest and patience.

Update: We performed GameGuard update to improve its compatibility and fix crashes between GameGuard and anti-virus software on 6:12 PM on August 3. Please close game and then run it again to update game and GameGuard.

Basic Troubleshooting

1. Log on as an administrator
GameGuard needs Windows administrator account. Please try to log on as an administrator and follow the link for your information. https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/help/14028/windows-7-how-log-on-as-an-administrator

2. Delete GameGaurd folder
GameGuard is automatically downloaded and updated when running LoveBeat and Canceling or stopping GameGuard update causes problems. You try to download and update again after you delete GameGuard folder in LoveBeat installation directory.
C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\LoveBeat (by default)

3. Turn off or Uninstall anti-virus software
Some anti-virus software block or conflict with LoveBeat, or using 2+ anti-virus software might cause problems. Please turn off or uninstall all anti-virus software including McAfee.

4. End unnecessary processes and software
Certain processes and software cause problems. Please end unnecessary processes and software in Task Manager, such as VPN, Sandboxie, Avast Online Scanner, other games which have game security solution (e.g. Xigncode) and so on.

5. Check the error code
If a message appears, please check what it says. If there is certain number (error code), please follow the link for troubleshooting: http://www.gameguard.co.kr/eng/index.htm

Contact LoveBeat Support

If the problem continues even after performing all of the troubleshooting steps in above guide, you will need to contact LoveBeat Support for further assistance. To ensure that your incident is handled in the quickest and most efficient manner possible, please follow these steps:

1. Prepare DxDiag.txt
Please observe the following instructions to run and save DxDiag.txt:
1) Press Windows Key + R
2) Type DxDiag and press Enter
3) In the DxDiag window, click Save All Information
4) Name the file "dxdiag" and click Save
5) Exit the DirectX Diagnostic Tool

2. Prepare GameGuard.zip
Please do the following to create GameGuard.zip:
1) Navigate to your LoveBeat installation directory
- By default: C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\LoveBeat
2) Right-click on GameGuard folder
3) Hover your cursor over the “Send to” option. it will open a new submenu
4) Select “Compressed (zipped) folder”

3. Prepare Screenshots
Please take a screenshot of your problem and all running processes in Task manager when you’re faced with the problem. You could open Task manager to press Ctrl+Alt+Delete.
Please follow the link about generating screenshots. http://www.take-a-screenshot.org/

4. Submit Your Support Request by email
Email lovebeat_cs@crazydiamond.co.kr to submit your request. Please write your LoveBeat name, Steam account, description about your problem and include your DxDiag.txt, GameGuard.zip, screenshot as an attachment to the incident.

notes.title: [Notice] Game&Game account won’t link to Steam version from June 1st, 2016 (Pacific time)
notes.notes:
Hello, all Game&Game members.

LoveBeat Game&Game service was closed and started on Steam on January, 2016.

For G&G members, applying to link LoveBeat G&G account to Steam version was accepted to this January and you could link it to Steam until now. Many G&G players have joined Steam, but some players don’t. I’d like to let the system which you can link it, but it would be removed on June 1st (Pacific time) because we have difficulty to manage the version.

I already emailed about this to G&G members who applied to link but didn’t join. If you applied to link but you didn’t login with the account, please join LoveBeat before June 1st. You cannot login with G&G account after maintenance on June 1st.

If you don’t know how to use Steam and link your account to Steam version, please read those guides.
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=599530044
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=575286090

Thank you.
